shows.title: Microchip Madness / Investigating Roswell
shows.first_half: First Half: Author and microchip expert Rakesh Kumar will explain how these chips power everything from smartphones and AI to critical infrastructure and national security. He'll discuss the growing global competition over semiconductors, their impact on innovation and the economy, and why the future of technology increasingly depends on chips.
shows.second_half: Second Half: UFO researcher and Roswell investigator Don Schmitt will discuss the latest developments in the Roswell case, including key witness testimony, the Walter Haut affidavit, and the Pentagon's recent treatment of evidence from the site.

shows.title: Healing Veterans / Spirit Messages
shows.first_half: First Half: Near-death experience researcher and veteran advocate Dannion Brinkley will discuss energetic medicine and emerging approaches to supporting veterans coping with traumatic brain injuries and PTSD. He'll also share accounts of unusual and paranormal experiences reported by vets during their service.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Psychic medium and intuitive mentor Monika Schaefer will share her approach to evidential mediumship and how she interprets messages that she believes come from spirit. She'll explain how she identifies personal details and life events, while also sharing practical guidance.

shows.title: Numerology for 2027 / Trusting Intuition
shows.first_half: First Half: Numerologist Glynis McCants will share her forecast for 2027 and explain how numerology may shape opportunities and challenges ahead. She'll also reveal the formula she uses to uncover an individual's soul purpose and discuss how understanding your personal numbers can help guide important life decisions.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Intuitive Tanya Carroll Richardson will discuss how angels, intuition, divine timing, and soul contracts shape our destinies. She'll explain how to recognize guidance during challenging times, as well as practical ways to deepen your connection to your soul and purpose.

shows.title: Bigfoot on Film / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Guest host Connie Willis (info) speaks with Bigfoot and UFO researcher Jan Maccabee about her ownership of the legendary Patterson-Gimlin film's 16mm reversal master footage. She'll talk about the ways her and her late husband preserved the film, its legal history, and Dr. Bruce Maccabee's analysis of the footage. Jan will also share additional insights about the enduring Bigfoot mystery. Followed by Open Lines in the latter half—give Connie a call and discuss whatever's on your mind!
